metadata.description: Copilot CLI plugin marketplace for Azure operators — Arc infrastructure management, Sovereign Landing Zones, and more

plugins.name: arc-infra-manager
plugins.description: Copilot CLI plugin for Azure Arc infrastructure operators covering fleet inventory, health monitoring, remote operations, patch management, compliance auditing, and reporting for hybrid Windows and Linux servers.

plugins.name: sovereign-landing-zone
plugins.description: Copilot CLI plugin for designing and deploying Azure Sovereign Landing Zones using Azure Verified Modules (AVM) Terraform modules. Features autonomous Terraform operations, sovereign compliance controls, and hub/vWAN networking.
